bib.title: Self-Distilled StyleGAN: Towards Generation from Internet Photos

question: How can StyleGAN be adapted to train on raw, uncurated Internet image collections that contain outliers and a multi-modal distribution?
hypothesis: A StyleGAN trained with an encoder can filter its own training data by reconstruction quality, and clustering its latent space gives a truncation trick that keeps diversity on multi-modal data.
contributions: Generative-based self-filtering of the dataset: outliers removed by LPIPS reconstruction error of a jointly trained StyleGAN2 and encoder
Multi-modal truncation: KMeans clusters of latent codes, truncating towards the perceptually nearest cluster center instead of the global mean
New datasets (SD-Flickr, SD-LSUN) and pre-trained models released

method.summary: Train StyleGAN2 jointly with an encoder on the raw collection, keep images whose LPIPS reconstruction distance is below a threshold (0.36 by default, bounded by an FID and a minimum-size constraint), then retrain StyleGAN2 from scratch on the filtered set. At inference, truncate each latent toward the nearest of 64 KMeans cluster centers (nearest by LPIPS) instead of the global mean.
method.task: unconditional image generation from uncurated Internet photo collections

datasets.name: LSUN bicycle, potted-plant, horse
datasets.size: at least 150,000 images per dataset after cropping
datasets.preprocessing: off-the-shelf object detector crops photos around the main object; trained at 256x256

datasets.name: Internet datasets (lions, elephants, dogs, parrots)
datasets.size: at least 150,000 images per dataset after cropping
datasets.source: simple web crawler using one keyword (e.g. 'parrot', 'dog'); non-proprietary parts re-gathered from Flickr with appropriate licences as SD-Flickr; filtered LSUN released as SD-LSUN

models.name: StyleGAN2 generator + encoder (self-filtering stage)
models.architecture: StyleGAN2 generator; encoder based on the StyleGAN2 discriminator architecture

other.implementation: own TensorFlow 2.0 StyleGAN2 implementation, hyperparameters as in the official one

models.name: StyleGAN2 final generator
models.init_from: from scratch on the filtered set

training.objective: L = L_GAN + lambda_w L_w + lambda_L1 L_rec,L1 + lambda_LPIPS L_rec,LPIPS; encoder reconstructs real and generated images and the latent w
training.steps: 250k steps (joint encoder-generator, self-filtering); final generator on filtered set 500K iterations in comparisons and ablations, 1500K iterations for final models

other.filter_threshold: theta_LPIPS = 0.36, subject to FID(Y,X) < FID(G(E(X)),X) and |Y| >= 70K
other.batch_size_note: batch size given only for the encoder-generator training

inference.decoding: multi-modal truncation: w_t = psi*w + (1-psi)*c_i, c_i the nearest cluster center

parameters.kmeans_fit: 60,000 latent codes from the mapping network; sklearn KMeans defaults except init=random
parameters.assignment: nearest center by LPIPS distance, not Euclidean latent distance
parameters.psi: varied in Fig 7; for user studies chosen per method to match FID (Table 2 values in brackets); exact psi values not given

metrics.name: FID
metrics.definition: FID of 50K generated images w.r.t. the generator's own training set (filtered or unfiltered)

metrics.name: % Real (AMT)
metrics.definition: single image shown 1.5 s, rater decides real or fake; percent judged real

metrics.name: AMT preference
metrics.definition: side-by-side triplet or pair, no time limit, rater picks the most realistic; percent favoured

baselines: StyleGAN2 on a random subset of the same size
clamping to global mean (Kynkaanniemi et al. 2019)
eval.protocol: AMT user studies; number of raters, number of images and significance tests not stated; single training run per setting, no seeds reported

availability.data: SD-Flickr and SD-LSUN on the project website

evidence.quote: we choose the truncation level for each setting such that the truncated generated images under both settings result in the same FID

results.claim: Self-filtering lowers FID on LSUN-Bicycle versus training on unfiltered data.
results.setup: StyleGAN2, LSUN-Bicycle 256x256, FID vs own training set, 50K samples, no truncation
results.table: Table 1, row LSUN-Bicycle, column Ours FID (w/o filtering 5.42)

results.claim: Self-filtering lowers FID on Internet Dogs.
results.setup: StyleGAN2, Internet Dogs 512x512, FID vs own training set, 50K samples
results.table: Table 1, row Internet Dogs, column Ours FID (w/o filtering 19.49)

results.claim: Humans judge more filtered-model images real on LSUN-Bicycle.
results.setup: AMT, image shown 1.5 s, real/fake decision, LSUN-Bicycle
results.table: Table 1, row LSUN-Bicycle, column %Real Ours (w/o filtering 55.0)

results.claim: Realism scores with self-filtering reach 60-70% across the tested datasets.
results.setup: AMT real/fake study, five datasets of Table 1
results.note: Table 1 shows a range of 60.1 to 73.8, so the 70% upper figure is approximate

results.claim: A random subset of the same size performs like unfiltered data, so the filtering method rather than the dataset size drives the gain.
results.setup: LSUN-bicycle, random subset of the same size as self-filtered set (filtered gives 3.66, unfiltered 5.42)

results.claim: Multi-modal truncation is preferred by raters over mean truncation at matched FID on Dogs.
results.setup: AMT triplet side-by-side, Internet Dogs, psi chosen so FID matches (27.37 vs 27.18); no truncation 8.1%
results.table: Table 2, row Internet Dogs, column Multi-modal Truncation

results.claim: Multi-modal truncation preferred on LSUN-Horse at matched FID.
results.setup: AMT triplet, LSUN-Horse, FID about 10.6 vs 11.4
results.table: Table 2, row LSUN-Horse, column Multi-modal Truncation

results.claim: Multi-modal truncation gives lower FID than global-mean truncation at equal truncation level, and the gap grows with truncation.
results.setup: 3 datasets, Fig 7; values only in a plot

results.claim: StyleGAN3 also benefits from filtering on LSUN-bicycle, but remains worse than filtered data would require.
results.setup: StyleGAN3 on LSUN-bicycle, filtered vs unfiltered; StyleGAN2 5.42 and 3.66
results.quote:
StyleGAN3 achieves an FID score
of 6.5 on unﬁltered data and 2.6 on our ﬁltered dataset.

results.claim: 64 clusters perform well on all datasets; Dogs prefers 128 (37.6%) over 32 (26.4%).
results.setup: AMT triplet of 32/64/128 clusters, Internet Dogs, 64 clusters

results.claim: LPIPS-based cluster assignment beats latent Euclidean assignment in AMT.
results.table: Table 5, row Latent Assignment vs Ours, column Lions

results.claim: Multi-modal truncation beats clamping toward the global mean at matched FID.
results.setup: AMT pairwise, Horses, parameters tuned to equal FID
results.table: Table 5, row Clamping vs Ours, column Horses

limits: Authors concede the quality/diversity tradeoff remains (improved) and the method still struggles with complicated backgrounds and scenes; fixing it would need architectural changes.
FID is measured against each generator's own training set (filtered or not), so FID values are not comparable across filtered and unfiltered rows beyond the stated protocol.
AMT study sizes (raters, images), significance tests, seeds and optimizer are not reported.
Filtering threshold 0.36 was set by visual inspection; only a few datasets (elephants, horses) hit the size or FID bound.
Semantic editing claims are qualitative (Fig 9) only; StyleGAN3 disentanglement left unchecked.

terms.definition: generative-based filtering that keeps images whose LPIPS reconstruction by the jointly trained generator and encoder is below a threshold
truncating a latent code toward the nearest of several cluster centers, w_t = psi*w + (1-psi)*c_i, rather than the global mean

lineage.note: source of the truncation trick that is generalized
encoder trained jointly on real and synthesized images
